unit: domain; policy differences average the 3 worker-specific paired differences
effect_direction: second minus first; worker high minus light
interval: 95% percentile bootstrap of available domain differences; per-outcome n_domains, 10000 draws, seed 20261013
test: two-sided exact sign-flip test of mean paired domain difference; 2**n assignments per outcome
multiplicity: Holm within 10 policy contrasts or 5 worker contrasts, separately for each metric
interpretation: Exploratory contrasts of the observed development domains; prospective hypotheses require their planned evaluation.
